_meta.title: 2 Corinthians — key verses per chapter (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Several curated key verses from each of the 13 chapters of 2 Corinthians. Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 47 2 Corinthians); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: several key verses per chapter (~1-4, scaled to chapter substance)
_meta.keying: book + chapter + citation; multiple records per chapter
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: KJV New Testament renders the divine name as 'Lord'/'God' (no tetragrammaton); text is verbatim KJV, except: whole-verse wrapping parentheses (5:7, 6:2, 10:4) removed and the editorial colophon appended to 13:14 dropped, for clean standalone display. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
verses.plain: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,

verses.text: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
verses.plain: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the same comfort we ourselves received from God.

verses.text: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
verses.plain: For no matter how many promises God has made, they are all 'Yes' in Christ — and so through him we say 'Amen' to the glory of God.

verses.text: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
verses.plain: Thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ and, through us, spreads the fragrance of knowing him everywhere.

verses.text: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
verses.plain: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.

verses.text: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
verses.plain: And we all, with unveiled faces, reflecting the Lord's glory, are being transformed into his image with ever-increasing glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.

verses.text: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
verses.plain: But we hold this treasure in clay jars, to show that this all-surpassing power is from God and not from us.

verses.text: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
verses.plain: So we don't lose heart. Though outwardly we are wasting away, inwardly we are being renewed day by day.

verses.text: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
verses.plain: For our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.

verses.text: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
verses.plain: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen — because what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.

verses.text: For we walk by faith, not by sight.
verses.plain: For we live by faith, not by sight.

verses.text: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
verses.plain: So if anyone is in Christ, they are a new creation. The old has gone; the new has come.

verses.text: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
verses.plain: God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

verses.text: For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.
verses.plain: For he says, 'In the time of my favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you.' I tell you, now is the time of God's favor; now is the day of salvation.

verses.text: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
verses.plain: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation and leaves no regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.

verses.text: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
verses.plain: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ: though he was rich, for your sakes he became poor, so that through his poverty you might become rich.

verses.text: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
verses.plain: Each of you should give what you've decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under pressure, for God loves a cheerful giver.

verses.text: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
verses.plain: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times, having all you need, you will overflow in every good work.

verses.text: For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;
verses.plain: The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of this world; they have divine power to tear down strongholds.

verses.text: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
verses.plain: We tear down arguments and every pretension that sets itself up against the knowledge of God, and we take every thought captive to make it obey Christ.

verses.text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
verses.plain: And no wonder — for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.

verses.text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
verses.plain: But he said to me, 'My grace is enough for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.' So I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ's power may rest on me.

verses.text: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
verses.plain: That's why, for Christ's sake, I take pleasure in weaknesses, insults, hardships, persecutions, and difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

verses.text: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
verses.plain: Finally, brothers and sisters, rejoice. Aim for full restoration, encourage one another, be of one mind, live in peace — and the God of love and peace will be with you.

verses.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
verses.plain: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
